title: Member Requests for Independent External Review of a Denied Exception (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a member may ask for an independent external review of a denied exception. When the member does, the review's priority (standard or expedited) is set from the member's records. The days of the drug the member has left are compared with the days a standard independent review would take.

## The member's own tool: `request_external_exception_review_e71b5dce`

**Capability.** One call adds one external review request to the denied request's case history. It is received at that moment, marked as asked for by the member, and carries the priority given. The review then shows as pending whenever the member's exception history is looked up. The tool makes this single write and checks nothing about admissibility or the value given.

**How it is invoked.** This is the member's own election. The agent unlocks `request_external_exception_review_e71b5dce` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the member) runs it to submit the review request.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `formulary_assignment_id` | reference number of the member's formulary assignment, as read out to the member from the formulary assignment lookup | identifier |
| `customer_id` | the member's own customer reference number, as read out to the member from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `source_exception_id` | reference number of the original exception request whose denial is to be reviewed, as read out to the member from the exception history (the request row itself, not its denial row) | identifier |
| `drug_name` | the drug of the denied request | exactly one drug master list name: atorvastatin, lisinopril, metformin, sertraline, levothyroxine, sumatriptan, oxycodone-acetaminophen, insulin glargine-yfgn, Lantus, Eliquis, Xarelto, Jardiance, Ozempic, Mounjaro, Wegovy, Zepbound, Trelegy Ellipta, Breztri Aerosphere, Nurtec ODT, Ubrelvy, Humira, adalimumab-adaz, Dupixent, Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Enbrel, Biktarvy, Ibrance |
| `review_priority` | `standard` (decided on the reviewer's standard timeframe) or `expedited` (decided on the reviewer's expedited timeframe) | enum |

A parameter's presence means only that the value is needed when the tool is run.

**Return.** The receipt carries:
- `formulary_exception_id`, the reference number of the review request;
- `source_exception_id`, the denied request under review;
- `drug_name`;
- `review_priority`, the priority recorded;
- `requested_by`, which is always member for this tool;
- `received_at`, the moment received;
- status "received".

Status "received" means the review request was submitted. No other outcome is defined.
